title: Разговор с ассистентом
description: Симуляция устной практике ответь ассистенту на вопросы о своём прошлом (готовый ответ — на экране).
task_context: Промпт для бота: "Act as a supportive English practice assistant. Ask me questions about my past and my experience." Задай ученику вопросы из списка checklist по одному и оцени ответы.

checklist.question: What did you do last weekend?
checklist.hint: I went to the park last weekend.

checklist.question: Have you ever travelled abroad?
checklist.hint: Yes, I have travelled abroad. I have been to Turkey.

checklist.question: When did you start learning English?
checklist.hint: I started learning English six years ago.

checklist.question: What was the most interesting place you have ever visited?
checklist.hint: The most interesting place I have ever visited is London.

checklist.question: Have you ever taken part in a school competition?
checklist.hint: Yes, I have taken part in a school competition.

checklist.question: What did you enjoy doing when you were younger?
checklist.hint: When I was younger, I enjoyed playing football.

checklist.question: What important thing have you learnt from your experience?
checklist.hint: I have learnt that practice is very important.
